headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw his 30th touchdown pass of the season on the game's opening drive and the Denver Broncos rolled to their eighth straight victory, beating the Oakland Raiders 26-13 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Broncos roll past Raiders for 8th straight win

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Sam Bradford threw a 13-yard touchdown pass to Brandon Gibson with 48 seconds left to lift the St. Louis Rams to a 15-12 win over the Buffalo Bills on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bradford lifts Rams past Bills in last minute

headlines.description: The grieving Cowboys rallied for a significant win on Sunday, beating the Cincinnati Bengals 20-19 on Dan Bailey's 40-yard field goal as time ran out.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys erase 9-point deficit to beat Bengals

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Cleveland Browns

headlines.description: Rookie Travis Benjamin's electrifying 93-yard punt return touchdown gave Cleveland momentum and the Browns won their third straight game, 30-7 over the emotionally drained Kansas City Chiefs on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Richardson ties Brown's rookie TD mark in win

headlines.description: Andrew Luck led Indianapolis back from a 13-point second-half deficit, and Adam Vinatieri made two fourth-quarter field goals as the Colts rallied for a 27-23 victory Sunday over the Tennessee Titans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck, Colts erase 13-point deficit, topple Titans

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson rushed for 154 yards and two touchdowns and Harrison Smith returned an interception for a score to lead the Minnesota Vikings to a 21-14 victory over the free-falling Chicago Bears on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson, surging Vikings roll past rival Bears

events.name: San Diego Chargers at Pittsburgh Steelers

headlines.description: Philip Rivers threw three touchdown passes, two to Danario Alexander, and the San Diego Chargers beat the Pittsburgh Steelers 34-24 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Chargers ruin Big Ben's return, swamp Steelers

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw a pair of touchdown passes in the final four minutes, including a 1-yarder to Jeremy Maclin with no time remaining Sunday as Philadelphia rallied to beat the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 23-21 and end an eight-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foles' heroics help Eagles snap 8-game skid

headlines.description: With Robert Griffin III sidelined with a sprained right knee, the Redskins rallied behind backup Kirk Cousins to tie the game, then Kai Forbath kicked a 34-yard field goal in overtime for a 31-28 victory over the Ravens.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins rallies Redskins following Griffin injury

headlines.description: Cam Newton threw for 287 yards and two touchdowns and scored on a 72-yard run as the Carolina Panthers defeated the Atlanta Falcons 30-20 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton dominates Falcons as Panthers hold on

events.name: New York Jets at Jacksonville Jaguars

headlines.description: Shonn Greene and Bilal Powell ran for short touchdowns and the New York Jets kept their postseason hopes alive with a 17-10 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets use running game to beat Jaguars

headlines.description: Frank Gore ran for a 1-yard touchdown, reached 1,000 yards rushing for the sixth time in his career, and the San Francisco 49ers beat the Miami Dolphins 27-13 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Gore, Kaepernick run in TDs as Niners prevail

events.name: New Orleans Saints at New York Giants

headlines.description: Rookie David Wilson returned a kickoff 97 yards for one touchdown, ran for two more scores and piled up 327 all-purpose yards and Eli Manning threw four touchdown passes to lead the New York Giants to s 52-27 win over the New Orleans Saints on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rookie Wilson sparks Giants in rout of Saints

headlines.description: Marshawn Lynch had three touchdown runs, and Seattle set a franchise record for points in a 58-0 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.

events.name: Detroit Lions at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: The Packers are a victory away from clinching the NFC North title after beating the Lions 27-20 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers tops Lions, close in on NFC North title

events.name: Houston Texans at New England Patriots

headlines.description: Tom Brady threw for four touchdowns and 296 yards as the New England Patriots manhandled the Houston Texans 42-14.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brady throws 4 TDs as Pats pick apart Texans
